project_name: Tiptii - Asilo Nido e Scuola dell'Infanzia SaaS Landing & Cookie Consent
theme: Light theme (Warm Cream #F6F5F0 + Salvia #2F7D6D + Pastel Accents)
design_philosophy: UX/UI 2026 - Organic Precision & Tactile Delight. Fusion of Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) and Archetype 3 (Soft Pastel & Playful) with modern 2026 glassmorphism, micro-interactions, scroll-driven staggered reveals, and interactive live previews.

fonts.display: Outfit, sans-serif (Rounded, friendly, confident for H1-H3)
fonts.body: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif (Clean, readable, geometric for body & UI)

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-[1.1]
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-snug

rules: Headings MUST use tight tracking (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
Labels/Badges MUST use uppercase + tracking-wider (tracking-[0.15em] or tracking-widest).
Never exceed text-6xl for main H1. Maintain 1.2-1.5x scale hierarchy between H1, H2, and H3.
All text contrast against backgrounds MUST strictly satisfy WCAG AA (4.5:1 min) or APCA standards.
Primary brand color #2F7D6D (Salvia) is reserved for main actions, active states, and brand anchors.
Accent Apricot #F2A65A is used for high-delight micro-highlights and energetic tags with dark text.
Never use pure #000000; use warm slate #2B2F33 for body and headers.
Cards have soft 1px solid border #E2DED6 with subtle shadow drop.

layout_and_grid.hero_layout: Asymmetric 2-column on desktop (lg:grid-cols-12, col-span-7 text & interactive CTAs, col-span-5 floating playful interactive illustration card stack).
layout_and_grid.bento_grid: Mode A Tetris Grid for Features: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 lg:gap-8 with varied heights (col-span-1/2, row-span-1/2).
layout_and_grid.spacing_scale: Generous spacing philosophy: py-16 md:py-24 lg:py-32 between major sections to let content breathe.
layout_and_grid.border_radius: Rounded-3xl (24px) for cards, rounded-2xl (16px) for inner containers, rounded-full for badges and pill buttons.

cookie_banner.placement: Floating bottom dock / toast bar with z-[100] fixed positioning.
cookie_banner.behaviour: Displays on first visit if no consent decision in localStorage ('tiptii_cookie_consent'). Dismisses instantly on Accept ('accepted') or Reject ('rejected').
requirements: MUST have ONLY two buttons: 'Accetta tutti' and 'Rifiuta' (Solo Accetta e Rifiuta).
MUST include a link to privacy policy: '/privacy#cookie'.
Visual style: 2026 organic glassmorphism panel (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90 border border-brand-light/60 shadow-2xl rounded-3xl p-5 md:p-6).
Micro-illustrations / badge: includes Tiptii footprint badge icon and cookie/shield icon.
Must support keyboard navigation and include data-testid attributes.

navigation_header.style: Sticky top-0 z-50 glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-stone-200/60 transition-all duration-300).
elements: Brand Logo (TiptiiLogo with footprint icon + wordmark).
CTA Button: 'Accedi' (Primary Salvia button linking to app login/dashboard).

motion_and_animations.scroll_reveal: Staggered fade-up entrances with viewport={{ once: true, margin: '-100px' }}.
motion_and_animations.hover_effects: Micro-lift hover: scale(1.02), translateY(-2px), shadow expansion, spring physics duration: 0.25s.
motion_and_animations.footprint_trail: Animated SVG footprint trail that lights up along scroll sequence.
motion_and_animations.accessibility: MUST wrap motion elements or respect `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` by disabling aggressive transforms.

testing_attributes.data_testid_convention: kebab-case role-based attributes on all key interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Build or update `/app/frontend/src/components/CookieBanner.jsx` with the exact choices ('Accetta tutti' / 'Rifiuta' + link '/privacy#cookie', saved in localStorage).
2. Render `<CookieBanner />` inside `App.js` or `Landing.jsx` so it is present across all public views.

3. Redesign `/app/frontend/src/pages/Landing.jsx` to deliver a top-tier 2026 UX/UI experience with vibrant interactive micro-widgets, colorful illustrations, smooth framer-motion reveals, and responsive bento grids.
4. Keep all existing text content, SEO structure (h1, h2, semantic structure), FAQ schema (JSON-LD), and Eligesoft S.r.l. details.
5. Ensure strict compliance with WCAG AA accessibility, prefers-reduced-motion, and responsive design (mobile-first).
